title: Lining up text of different sizes
summary: align-items: baseline lines up the text inside items of different font sizes, where center would not.
explanation: Items with different font sizes look misaligned with align-items: center, because their boxes are centred, not their text. baseline lines up the first line of text in each item instead.
Baseline alignment is for text. It works well for a label next to a large value, and it is a good fit for form-like rows where the labels are small and the values are big.
tryThis: Change align-items to center and compare how the small label sits against the value.
Set align-self: flex-end on .unit: it drops to the bottom edge, breaking the shared baseline.
Change the value's font size and see the baseline stay in place.
